scope: Independent design, phase-ordering, orchestration capability and staged comfort scope review; not final implementation code review.
accepted_reasoning: Design priority order rewards observation, qualitative growth, varied class perspectives and systemic consequence instead of content volume or damage inflation.
Host-owned campaign state, idempotent intent handling, save recovery and version compatibility are appropriate future contracts; none is implemented in game by these documents.

The comfort patch remains narrowly scoped, defaults off, and records no full-game compile or player comfort claim. Broad weapon motion, frame timing, per-player persisted UI and symptom cause remain unresolved.

The coordinator contains executable queue/state/claim/handoff/local-subprocess primitives, so it is more than role-label documentation. Native model invocation still requires the active root; configured roles do not prove agents ran.
Atomic orchestration JSON is not game persistence, and durable task records alone are not continuous or crash-resuming execution.
Empty world/narrative schema work is allowable pre-gate preparation. It does not establish authored depth or justify filling content now.

findings.summary: Gate attestations accept empty artifacts and insufficient subject/provenance evidence.
evidence: Engine._validate_evidence_artifact hashes any file without nonempty/structured checks.
Engine._validate_evidence_body accepts unexecuted argv and zero exit metadata; playtest only needs nonempty observations and environment.
subject_task_ids defaults to an empty list, making required independence vacuous.
An isolated temporary-fixture run passed vanilla.build with an empty file and unexecuted command metadata, then launch and comfort with generic text.
findings.change_request: Use gate-specific validated evidence records with mandatory subject tasks, source/binary/configuration identity, observer provenance, required checks, nonempty referenced artifacts and independent review as appropriate. Keep attestation trust explicit; do not present JSON validation as proof of human play.
findings.acceptance: Negative tests reject empty, malformed, missing subject, missing binary/environment/checks, self-reviewed and stale evidence; real positive fixtures pass only the intended tooling checks. Final independent reviewer confirms this against the final implementation.

findings.summary: Hidden generation gate omits the required four-player baseline.
evidence: firewall.secret_generation_gate and content_rules.generation_gate name comfort.accepted.
An isolated metadata-only hidden task became available while multiplayer.four_player remained unknown.
findings.change_request: Require adventure_core.ready or an equivalent aggregate of all prerequisite runtime gates in every content-generation path and role prompt. Keep schema-only preparation distinct.
findings.acceptance: A comfort pass with four-player unknown/failed cannot enable authored content; both prerequisites are needed and invalidation closes access again.

findings.summary: Resume currently reloads status but does not recover interrupted work or retry failures.
evidence: CLI maps resume to Engine.status.
There is no task retry, stale-claim reconciliation, lease/attempt state or bounded recovery transition in the inspected engine.
A worker/process interrupted after claim can leave claimed work and write ownership indefinitely.
findings.change_request: Implement an explicit bounded recovery/retry workflow, or narrow the deliverable claim to durable checkpoint inspection and list recovery as unfinished. Require safe reconciliation before rerunning potentially side-effecting commands.
findings.acceptance: Controlled interruption and failed-task tests demonstrate recovery without duplicate completion, conflicting ownership or unbounded retries; no always-on/native invocation claim without actual service/tool execution.

findings.summary: Declared spoiler firewall does not cover the actual internal_spoilers root and is not an export implementation.
evidence: Actual schema ledgers are under internal_spoilers/ while configured secret_prefixes includes docs/internal_spoilers but not internal_spoilers/.
Path declarations are trusted metadata; a public read of an ancestor directory can overlap secrets without is_under_any recognizing it.
CLI dispatch/gaps can print or write internal payloads; those are internal tools, not validated player exports.
findings.change_request: Cover actual hidden roots and ancestor overlaps; provide an explicit sanitized export path before calling the firewall an enforced player export boundary. Clearly describe metadata validation versus process sandboxing.
findings.acceptance: Representative secret-root, ancestor-read and arbitrary-output tests fail closed for public exports; normal internal reports remain internal and player outputs only contain allowlisted fields.

findings.summary: Player priorities need experiential acceptance beyond structural/network validity.
evidence: DESIGN_BIBLE states discovery and class priorities, but no-wiki learning and all-four engagement require concrete later playtest criteria.
A valid accessibility path or connected four-peer session cannot establish that each participant made meaningful choices.
findings.change_request: Require blind tests for in-world learnability, qualitative choice changes without repeated farming, viable composition alternatives with class identity, and contribution opportunities for every participant. Avoid a scalar AI fun score or quotas for rooms/discoveries as acceptance.
findings.acceptance: Systems design explicitly separates automated invariants from human judgments of understanding, surprise, agency, tension and cooperation; reports avoid revealing intended answers.
findings.resolution: Independently inspected systems-audit.json and SYSTEMS_INTERFACES.md. Explicit criteria cover in-world learnability, no required farming, all-same-class parties, every participant contribution and human experiential feedback. Runtime acceptance remains untested.

findings.summary: Several bootstrap documents describe different snapshots as current.
evidence: Content audit says Windows target is established; director and player status call target OS unconfirmed.
Content audit describes an older comfort camera coverage than current comfort-plan/COMFORT.md.
System PATH CMake absence and locally provisioned CMake attempts both occur and need scope labels.
findings.change_request: Reconcile user-established target facts and label dated/source-snapshot observations; update final player-safe capability status from final evidence.
findings.acceptance: One consistent final status describes target facts, local tool scope, staged coverage and blocked runtime gates without claiming old findings are current defects.

findings.summary: Campaign recovery needs a single authoritative commit point and bounded receipt replay policy.
evidence: Systems design replaces the candidate snapshot before appending the committed journal marker.
Recovery says prepared but uncommitted operations are discarded, leaving the after-replace/before-marker crash case ambiguous.
Operation receipts are bounded but delayed duplicate intent behavior after receipt eviction is unspecified.
findings.change_request: Define whether durable snapshot installation or journal commit marker is authoritative, reconcile the crash window accordingly, and define operation-ID replay rejection or compaction guarantees after receipt eviction.
findings.acceptance: Design enumerates crash outcomes before/after each durable step; no acknowledged commit is lost and no applied operation replays twice; late duplicate requests remain rejected/idempotent after receipt pruning.
findings.resolution: Independent reread confirms snapshot installation is authoritative, after-replace/before-marker recovery rolls forward, fault injection covers every boundary, and persisted actor sequences/high-water marks reject compacted retries. Platform durability still requires implementation and runtime tests.

findings.summary: Spoiler-blind player wording was interpreted as visual impairment without evidence.
evidence: Systems design calls for blind target player access that cannot rely on map sight or unvoiced visual detail.
findings.change_request: Refer to spoiler-blind testing and retain multimodal accessibility as a general design principle without claiming an unreported user disability.
findings.acceptance: No inference of literal blindness appears in user-specific acceptance criteria.
findings.resolution: Independent reread confirms spoiler-blind wording, explicit prohibition of disability assumptions, and accessibility based on stated needs and observations.

adversarial_fixture_result.writes: temporary directory only; no secret content authored

required_future_experience_evidence: Blind players can infer actionable possibilities and consequences from the game without external documentation or revealed solutions.
Qualitative development changes choices and relationships without requiring repeated low-information farming.
Class identities expose different meaningful approaches while supported parties retain feasible progress and recovery.
All four participants can contribute decisions or actions; success is not solely host progress with three spectators.
Automated checks establish modeled correctness only; human reports establish comfort and experiential quality.
limitations: The checkout is being edited concurrently; hashes identify this review snapshot.
Final implementation code review belongs to a separate independent reviewer.
No full game compilation, runtime, four-player session or subjective comfort measurement was performed by this critic.
No authored content was created and no hidden discoveries are included.
